title: Oozy Velvety Russian Egg Spring Rolls
description: A salty and cozy Russian dish featuring egg rolls with a mother sauce base, served in a lacquerware bowl. This high protein friendly meal is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together eggs, flour, milk, butter, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Heat a small amount of vegetable oil in a non stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of the egg mixture into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Once the egg is almost set, place a spring roll wrapper on top and fold the edges to seal.
Roll the egg and wrapper into a tight cylinder and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Serve the egg rolls in a lacquerware bowl with a side of mother sauce for dipping.
To make the mother sauce, combine equal parts sour cream and mayonnaise with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Stir the sauce until smooth and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Heat the egg rolls in the oven at 350 degrees for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs and serve immediately.
